title: Light Tender Ethiopian Goat Meat Misir Wot
description: A sweet and tender one-pot Ethiopian dish featuring goat meat, this recipe is a variation of the traditional misir wot, made with raw-friendly ingredients and a focus on tenderizing the goat meat.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the goat meat and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the berbere spice, tomato paste, red wine, beef broth, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Use two forks to shred the goat meat into bite-sized pieces.
Continue to simmer the mixture for another 30 minutes, or until the meat is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Serve the misir wot hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions.
